data.name: Jamiilat
data.gender_notes: Jamiilat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jamīl', which means 'beautiful', 'handsome' or 'attractive'. The name Jamiilat carries the meaning “Beautiful, attractive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Jamiilat usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, attractive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reflects inner and outer beauty, and the desire to bring happiness and joy to others.
data.etymology: Jamiilat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, attractive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamiilat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
